newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-May textile exports up 33 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-May textile exports up 33 pct.

text.p: China exported textiles and garments worth $16 billion in the January-May period, up 33 percent compared with the same period in 1996, the China Securities newspaper said on Wednesday.

Sales revenues reached 30.5 billion yuan ($3.67 billion) from January to May, down four percent compared with the year-ago period with the sales-to-production ratio at 95.7 percent, up about one percentage point, it said, quoting a survey on state enterprises in 38 major cities.
Loss-making textile enterprises accounted for 56 percent of the total, down by four percentage points compared with the year-ago period, it quoted the survey as saying.
Losses from the loss-making enterprises totalled 1.8 billion yuan in January to May, or a decline of 600 million yuan compared with the same period in 1996, it said. It gave no more details.
